title: OpenAPI-driven API fuzzing (RESTler)
steps: Fetch `/openapi.json`, `/swagger.json`, or `/api-docs`; save the spec and note auth headers.
`restler compile --api-spec spec.json --output out`; inspect the generated grammar for stateful sequences.
Run `restler fuzz --grammar out/Compile/grammar.py --host <target> --token <token>` with a small time box.
Triage 500s/schema violations/auth bypasses; replay the minimal sequence and confirm the flag path.
falsifier: The API is stateless or the spec is incomplete; RESTler finds only expected validation errors.
